payload.summary: scope: the scripted end-to-end playthrough test. A fixed command sequence driven through the CLI against a seeded deal, asserting exact engine outcomes — deal legality, refutation identity and order, a wrong accusation eliminating the accuser while leaving them refuting, and a correct accusation ending the game. Runs with the LLM stubbed so it proves game legality never depends on model output; a separate live-key path exercises the real endpoint and asserts usage numbers are captured. Depends on cli-ui. Discharges nothing about the first-scaffold obligation by itself — nahel doctor must still exit 0.
